gnosh mcp add-json

  Add a server from its entry, as JSON. The entry is what goes under the
  server's name in "mcpServers", such as {"type": "http", "url":
  "https://..."}. With - in its place the entry is read from standard input,
  so that a key in it stays off the command line.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh mcp add-json [flags] <name> <json>

Flags
  -s, --scope <scope>
      Where the server is kept: local (this project, for you alone: the
      default for add), user (every project of yours) or project (the
      project's .mcp.json, which goes with it). (Not built yet.)
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
